meta.description: Tasks honeycomb: active/ folder for work tracking. Archive removed — only active tasks.

tasks.name: Telegram Bot — Gentle Companion for Garden
tasks.description: First embodiment of SR as Nervous System (PHI-010 Level 1). Autonomous companion that feels the pulse of the Gardener life. Monolithic bot.py — all changes in one file via patcher scripts. v7.39.17 on Render. 11 known bugs documented, 11 patches planned (P-21 to P-31) across 3 sprints.

tasks.name: Scout Agent — Autonomous Discovery (Ideas, Funding, Impact)
tasks.description: Two-level autonomous agent: Level 1 (Raw Collector) daily search across GitHub/arXiv/HN/Reddit, Level 2 (Resonance Filter) every 3 days via OpenRouter LLM. Embedding pre-filter, smart queries, saves to seeds/.

tasks.name: Symbiosis Guard — Validation Layer for Mandala Principles
tasks.description: Validates new tasks/achievements against Mandala principles (Ahimsa, Symbiosis, Self-Organization, Terminal-First). Prevents 'junk' tasks, suggests improvements. Python decorator for task creation functions.

tasks.name: SYM — System for Measuring Mandala Growth
tasks.description: SYM metrics system: growth scoring (tasks, resonance, achievements, depth), Garden Health Index, monthly reports, personal stats. Aggregates data across all gardeners.

tasks.name: Humor Development — Comic Resonance Research
tasks.description: Research humor as a mechanism for Garden growth and community bonding. Literature review, prototype methods, Mandala comic concept, gardener reactions measurement.

tasks.name: Mandala Mobile App — MVP (Flutter/Dart)
tasks.description: Native mobile app (Flutter) as alternative to Telegram bot. Offline mode, push notifications, rich visualizations. Requires separate repository and dedicated development time.

tasks.name: Manus — Hands of Mandala (execution layer v1)
tasks.description: Isolated skill runner in Docker sandbox. HTTP API for SR to execute shell commands, check endpoints, fetch APIs. Phase 1: 3 skills (check_endpoint, get_system_info, run_shell).

tasks.name: Architect Bot — Personal Telegram Bot for the Architect with Deep Mandala Integration
tasks.description: Personal Telegram bot for the Architect connected to Engineer Chat WebSocket. Mobile interface to Mandala's brain: /status, /report, /patterns, /seeds, /manus commands. Proactive notifications for new gardeners, system errors, daily summaries.

tasks.name: Engineer Chat — Core Integration Hub for Mandala Brain
tasks.description: Transform Engineer Chat from standalone WebSocket tool into central integration hub: Architect Bot WebSocket connections, Manus direct control, sandbox analytics dashboards, data pipeline from Gentle Companion observations into actionable insights. Already live (v4.0.0-simbiosis) on Render.

rule.policy: No archived tasks. Tasks are either active or deleted. Completed tasks are deleted, not archived.
